info.name: TaskFlow API
info.description: Every endpoint of the TaskFlow task management API (NTU AIE Module 3). Set baseUrl if the API is not on localhost:8080.

request.description: 200 with a bare JSON array. Six seed tasks are present at startup.
200 with the task, 404 with an error body for an unknown id, 400 for a non-numeric id.
201 with the created task. Only title is required; status defaults to todo and priority to medium. A blank title or an unknown status/priority is a 400.

body.raw:
{
  "id": 3,
  "title": "Build login page",
  "description": "Create a login form with email and password fields and basic validation.",
  "status": "done",
  "priority": "high",
  "completed": false
}

request.description: 200 with the updated task. Full replacement. status is the source of truth: this body sets status done, so completed comes back true even though the body says false.
200 with the task, status done and completed true.
200 with an empty body, 404 for an unknown id.
200 with a short plain-English summary. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment; without it the API answers 502.
